subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate option to improve the underlined segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to improve it, select ‘No improvement required’.**

I enjoy __watch__ historical movies.
solution:
The correct answer is '**watching**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is **grammatically incorrect.**
 
• Here, '**watching**' should be used instead of '**watch**'.
 
• When '**enjoy, admit and mind**' are followed by another verb, it must be in the** -ing form.**
 
• *Example: *
 
 
• *I enjoy traveling. *
 
• *He admitted stealing the necklace.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is** Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *I enjoy **watching** historical movies.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहाँ '**watch**' के स्थान पर '**watching**' का प्रयोग करना चाहिए।
 
• जब **'enjoy, admit and mind'** के बाद दूसरी **verb** आती है, तो यह **-ing form** में होना चाहिए।
 
• *Example: *
 
 
• *I enjoy traveling. *
 
• *He admitted stealing the necklace.*
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4** है।
